item.description:
My name is Cam, and I’m an investigative and data reporter. I’m looking for a new job! 🔎

  • I’m based in Chicago, Illinois, an incredible city for journalism and hearty meals.
  • I’ve centered my career working on in-depth stories with local impact.
  • My favorite roles have an overlap of enterprise, investigative, data and service journalism.
  • The best way to contact me is heycamrodriguez@gmail.com .

Currently, I’m a Local Investigations Fellow at The New York Times, which has me criss-crossing Illinois in pursuit of stories about the presence of the shipping and logistics industry, one of the fastest-growing industries in the state.

Hi! For a good stretch of time, I was looking for a new full-time reporting job. I’m not anymore! If you’ve come across this, possibly from bit.ly/cam-rodriguez-one-sheet, thank you for clicking through and checking me out. The best way to get in touch with me is heycamrodriguez@gmail.com .

I really liked formatting my skills like this, though, and find it to be a valuable resource. I’m keeping it up for posterity, until I update my professional website and portfolio! :)
